listType.title: List type
listType.description: Which ESPPRA listing to scrape. "Tenders" = currently open for bidding. "Award intentions" = notice of intention to award, published before contract signature (large, 1,500+). "Suspended suppliers" = the debarment register (small).

maxResults.title: Max results
maxResults.description: Caps how many rows are scraped for this run, across as many pages as needed. Ignored for "suspended_suppliers" (single small call, everything comes back at once).

keyword.title: Keyword filter (optional)
keyword.description: Filters by procuring entity name, tender title, or procurement method. Applies to "tenders" and "award_intentions" only (server-side search); ignored for "suspended_suppliers". Leave blank to fetch everything.
